title: Read a remote evidence file
responsibility: Accept supported remote evidence bytes only when their stated size and hash match the requested file.

inputs.name: remoteArtifact.value
inputs.description: The recorded file as a computer sent it or as the phone kept it: base64 data with its mediaType, its decoded byteLength and its lowercase hex sha256. It is decoded only when its mediaType is in artifactMediaTypes, its byteLength is not above artifactLimit and its sha256 equals asked; remoteBinary then refuses it unless encoding is 'base64', data is a base64 string and the decoded length and SHA-256 match byteLength and sha256.

inputs.name: remoteArtifact.asked
inputs.description: The SHA-256 the caller asked for, as 64 lowercase hex characters, which must equal the value's sha256 exactly. An undefined or empty value, or one that differs, is refused with otherArtifact before any bytes are decoded.

outputs.name: artifactLimit
outputs.description: The largest raw byte length accepted for one recorded artifact: 11 * 1024 * 1024 bytes, which is 11 MiB. A byteLength above it is refused with largeArtifact; the file is never cut.

outputs.name: artifactMediaTypes
outputs.description: The media types a recorded artifact may have, compared exactly: image/png, image/jpeg, audio/wav, audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, audio/ogg, application/json and text/plain; charset=utf-8. Any other media type is refused with unshownArtifact, and markup and anything a browser would run are not in the list.

outputs.name: unshownArtifact
outputs.type: "The computer sent a recorded file of a kind this app does not show."
outputs.description: The message of the Error that remoteArtifact throws when the value is absent or its mediaType is missing or not in artifactMediaTypes.
examples: The computer sent a recorded file of a kind this app does not show.

outputs.name: largeArtifact
outputs.type: "The recorded file is too large to be read on this connection."
outputs.description: The message of the Error that remoteArtifact throws when Number(byteLength) is above artifactLimit.
examples: The recorded file is too large to be read on this connection.

outputs.name: otherArtifact
outputs.type: "The computer sent another recorded file than the one asked for."
outputs.description: The message of the Error that remoteArtifact throws when sha256 is missing or differs from asked, undefined asked included.
examples: The computer sent another recorded file than the one asked for.

outputs.name: remoteArtifact
outputs.description: The decoded bytes as a Uint8Array, with the value's mediaType and sha256; the sha256 is the one remoteBinary verified as the SHA-256 of those bytes. The promise resolves only after the media type, size and requested-hash checks pass and remoteBinary has decoded the data.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown as an Error with the message of unshownArtifact when the value is absent or its mediaType is missing or not in artifactMediaTypes, of largeArtifact when Number(byteLength) is above artifactLimit, or of otherArtifact when sha256 is missing or differs from asked. Rejections from remoteBinary pass through: its unreadableMedia message when encoding is not 'base64', data is not a string or data cannot be decoded as base64, and its damagedMedia message when the decoded length or SHA-256 differs from byteLength or sha256.
